methodology.purpose: Read-only inventory of recovery potential from already-retained Sumy source provenance before any new manual web research.
methodology.source_scope: Current QA bundle, current source-retention audit, final historical evidence, and existing retained historical source corpus in the repository.
safety_rules: Do not combine separate incidents from the same article/day.
Do not use page-wide city context as event binding unless deterministic.
Do not use headlines as event-specific evidence unless source structure deterministically ties them to the event.
Do not change replay or historical classifications.
Do not append or mutate evidence.
Do not rerun source-retention repairs or full historical replay.
